verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly assigns three trial video-editing artifacts, identifies their source content, and defines approval against style and brand standards as the acceptance condition.
The client narrows the trial clips' source-content constraint to the provided YouTube channel; replacing the existing source_content value leaves no stale attribute requiring removal.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports completing and attaching all three trial clips for review.
First concrete verification: the client reports reviewing the submitted trial artifacts, judging them good, and confirming that the freelancer passed.
